tasks.extracted: Covariates were prespecified for the model of each outcome (publisher page, Methods), and the adjusted nonfatal overdose estimate carries its own table note (g), unlike the behaviour estimates (d). As read in the PubMed Central copy, note g lists for the overdose model: baseline strip use, state, age, race, ethnicity and sex, and, for each drug-use day, the drug category, study week, part of the week, the composite risk-reduction score and the number of times strips were used. Injecting, past 30-day overdose, ever having received strip instructions, education and employment are not in it (past overdose and strip instructions are in the behaviour models, note d; injecting is in neither). Editors' reading: the follow-up score and strip-use count come after the exposure and may carry part of any effect, which could pull the adjusted ratio towards 1.
